Interactive liver-injury screening scatter (eDISH / mDISH / cholestatic)

Source: R/plot_edish.R
plot_edish_interactive.Rd

Builds an interactive plotly scatter plot sharing the same classification and axis rules as plot_edish(), with subject-level hover tooltips showing peak values, peak dates, directed peak gaps (BILI - ALT/AST or BILI - ALP), concurrent status, ALP window/missing flags, and R-ratio.

Usage

plot_edish_interactive(
  adsl = NULL,
  adlb = NULL,
  classified = NULL,
  which = c("edish", "mdish", "cholestatic"),
  color_by = c("arm", "quadrant"),
  log_axes = TRUE,
  facet = FALSE,
  annotate_quadrants = TRUE,
  mark_potential = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  show_caption = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

adsl, adlb

Passed to classify_hyslaw() when classified is NULL.

classified

Optional list from classify_hyslaw().

which

"edish" is peak ALT or AST / ULN vs peak BILI / ULN; "mdish" uses peak / baseline; "cholestatic" is peak ALP / ULN vs peak BILI / ULN.

color_by

"arm" colors points by the grouping variable (default, for treatment imbalance). "quadrant" colors by screening quadrant.

log_axes

If TRUE, both axes use log10 scales.

facet

If TRUE, facet by the grouping variable when it has at least two levels. Default FALSE keeps arms on one panel.

annotate_quadrants

If TRUE, print quadrant names in the corners.

mark_potential

If TRUE, overlay open red circles on biochemical potential Hy's Law (eDISH / mDISH) or concurrent cholestatic cases.

title

Plot title. Generated from which when NULL.

show_caption

If TRUE (default), render the screening note as a bottom plot annotation with extra bottom margin. Set to FALSE when the caller renders the caption outside the widget (as in tm_g_edish()).

...

Passed to classify_hyslaw().

Value

A plotly (htmlwidget) object.

Details

Red open circles for biochemical potential / concurrent cases skip hover so each subject produces a single tooltip. Quadrant corner labels are placed as non-interactive layout annotations.

Examples

data <- make_synthetic_hyslaw_data(n_extra = 0L, seed = 1L)
plot_edish_interactive(data$ADSL, data$ADLB)


plot_edish_interactive(data$ADSL, data$ADLB, which = "cholestatic")
